snippet.title: Pet Pet Pet: Tidy Up! Trailer
snippet.description:
3,000 sleepy pets have taken over your shop. Scoop up kittens and puppies from 150+ adorable breeds, tuck each one into its matching bed, and watch total chaos turn into a perfectly organized pet paradise. No timers. No pressure. Just pets.

Now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5150210/Pet_Pet_Pet_Tidy_Up/
